name: Pyramids Apt. 2
headline: Jacuzzi Studio By The Historic Pyramids (Apt.2)
summary: Step into Pyramids Apartments, where ancient wonders meet modern comfort, Start your day with pyramid views from your window, and end it soaking in your own private in-room jacuzzi.

description.Space:
This bright and cozy apartment is designed for relaxation and comfort, perfect after a full day exploring the pyramids and the lively streets of Giza.
Inside, you’ll find:

✔️ A private indoor jacuzzi, thoroughly cleaned and sanitized before every stay
✔️ One Queen-sized bed with hotel-quality Egyptian cotton linens
✔️ A bathroom stocked with fresh face and body towels
✔️ A compact kitchenette for light meal preparation
✔️ Free Wi-Fi, Cable TV, and Chromecast
✔️ A Nespresso machine
✔️ Complimentary bottled water and two coffee capsules
description.Access:
✔️Guests will have full private access to the Apartment and all of its amenities during their stay.
✔️For larger groups or multiple bookings, feel free to contact us — we may have additional units available in the same building or nearby.
description.Interaction:
✔️We’re available to assist you between 9:00 AM and 4:00 AM Cairo time.
✔️Whether you have questions before arrival or need help during your stay, our team is happy to support you via Airbnb messages throughout your experience.
description.Neighborhood:
⚠️Please note that occasional water or electricity outages may also occur due to local infrastructure maintenance. These are usually resolved quickly, we appreciate your understanding.

✔️ Safety & Accessibility
Despite the humble setting, the area is generally safe and the location provides unbeatable access to the Giza Pyramids.
✔️ Authentic Local Surroundings
The apartment is well-maintained and just as shown in the photos, but the neighborhood offers a modest, authentic experience. Streets may be dusty, unpaved, or littered, common in areas around the Pyramids. If you’re seeking polished or luxury surroundings outside the apartment, this may not be the right fit.
description.Transit:
✔️ Location: Just a short walk to the Giza Pyramids main gate, perfect for sightseeing.
✔️ Transportation: Uber, In-drive, and local taxis are easily available 24/7.
✔️ Private Services: We offer convenient airport pickup, drop-off, and private guided tours across Cairo and Giza. Just message us to arrange in advance.

⚠️ Parking is not provided. Guests may use nearby street or private parking (subject to availability).

reviews.review: Habitación confortable con vistas increíbles.

I really enjoyed my stay here. The location is excellent. I arranged transportation from the airport directly through the host for $25 which made it super easy, especially traveling by myself. The area is very safe and you will find everything you need in the area. The host also offers tours which also made everything very convenient for me. I will definitely return.
Bob was extremely helpful, kind and a very inspiring man. Thank you for everything!

Such a great place to stay with an amazing view of the pyramids. John was an outstanding host - extremely responsive, provided a bunch of local tips, and made sure we had an easy time checking in and out. The location was also extremely accessible to many of the activities we wanted to do. Would definitely recommend.
A lovely place with the best views of the city!

This must be hands down the most stunning and affordable place to stay at while you're in Egypt! We woke up every morning an incredible view of the Pyramids, and watched the sun set behind them every day. The apartment was a bit tricky to find, but all of the details are listed in the check-in instructions, and check-in was extremely easy since there is a lock box provided. 

Aside from the incredible view, the apartment was tastefully furnished; the kitchen is complete with all the basic utensils, dishes, and pots/pans; the bathroom was lovely (although the water pressure wasn't great,) and the fridge was even stocked with complimentary water and juice boxes. During the evening we would sit in the jacuzzi and watch movies with the view of the Pyramids behind us. 

Communication was fast and reliable. When my boyfriend and I ran out of toilet paper John was quick to deliver more to us, and he was also extremely responsive through whatsapp. We will definitely stay here again and have also recommended the airbnb to many of our other friends. <3

It was a great stay!  Looks exactly like as advertised. There are some supermarkets and a fruit store nearby. Walking distance to The Sphinx. Friendly neighborhood. 
Highly recommended this property!
One of the top best places to stay in Cairo!
Amazing view of the pyramids. Like the close proximity to the pyramids. In addition, enjoyed the jacuzzi and the light show from the comfort of the apartment.

An amazing view and host. I highly recommend booking tours through Xuru as it comes with a private tour guide which is your driver that picks you up from the airport. You really get your bang for you buck. The hospitality was awesome. Whenever I visit Cairo this will prob be the only airbnb I book just based off location, the hospitality, they are available with questions when needed, everything you can hope for. Bob our private transfer and tour guide was awesome. Thanks again for opening up your home!

The view in the photos is absolutely real. The apartment was clean and contained everything we needed. A bit difficult to find but they give great picture directions. I think it’s literally as close to the pyramids as you could possibly get.
Fantastic studio apartment with a great view. Everyone was so kind to us and happy that we were there. The host responded quickly to any questions we asked.

We loved our stay here.. the space is exactly as pictured.. the area is very accessible to the pyramids.. and everything was perfect!! We’d highly recommend staying here.. Also don’t let the exterior deceive you, it’s very safe and the locals are super friendly and helpful..

wonderful

It's hard to review the apartment, because I never got a chance to stay there. This is my complete story of what happened. 
John asked if I would like a driver to meet at airport I said yes that would be great. When we arrive, our driver was there. I thought I would just be getting dropped off at the apartment but that was not the case at all. Before we left airport we asked driver if we could get some currency exchange before we left and he said let's go to bank and do it okay that was fine. So we get on the road, the whole time he has his phone to his nose weaving in and out of traffic going incredibly fast. Yes they drive crazy in cairo. But not like this this was the most scared I have ever been in a vehicle. Drivers were honking at him nonstop, a driver got very close to car rolled down his window and asked our driver what he was doing and our driver swerved to the other side of road. I started to get very upset and told the driver that I was scared and he said okay okay one hour until bank. We get to bank, he comes in with us, and sees we exhange $100 US which is about $1700 LE. We get back to car and once again the crazy driving begins. This time it is accompanied by him trying to sell himself to us. He asked what we were doing on our last day In Cairo We said we just wanted to go to pyramids. So he's telling us let him give us a tour he would take us to pyramids, bazaar, restaurant, ECT. It's 3 PM at this point (We got picked up at noon) we told him no thanks. We literally drove for 2 and a half hours while.he kept begging us saying no charge no charge. I messaged John and asked how far it was until apartment and he said 1 hour. Our driver was acting like he had no idea where he was going was very very heavily relying on GPS. We pulled out pur gps and we was going the wrong direction. My husband called him out on it and he said oh you have GPS yes i made a wrong turn and turned around. So we finally get to apartment. Great i think we will never have to see him again he's just the driver after all. Wrong. He said he was going to escort us to apartment. So he goes up stairs with us and once inside apartment tells us look this place is not safe. If people see you have money they will rob you. Never walk alone you need me as your guide or you will not be safe. For only 1700 LE I will guide you everywhere. YEP. exactly every penny he knew we had. We told him no thanks we just wanted to go to pyramids by our self. Fine fine he said. Ill.take you I don't have my tourism license so I can't go in with you so let me tell you everything here. He opens windows of John's apartment which has a beautiful view of pyramids. And explains for 30 minutes details about the pyramids. I told him look we already had a tour I just want to go and look at them once more. He said I'm almost done almost done. It's 3:30 now pyramids close at 6. He gets done with his spill. And says ok ill wait outside for 30 minutes for you guys to discuss and decide if you want tour. We told him no again. We know we have to leave now enjoy our last day. So we grab our stuff and leave. He follows us. He yelled at us. Told us once again it wouldn't be safe without him guiding us. So we decided not to return to the apartment and stayed at a hostel for $30 instead where we weren't harassed. If $80 and an amazing view  is worth 5 hours of aggravation and threatened your safety then this is the place.  But if not there are many other options.  Please read this warning before agreeing to let John get you a driver. P.s. the elevator doesn't work if someone forgets to close door, which was the case for us going up. This is on the 10th floor. That is all.
